title: Crystal River Tiki Tour

services.name: Tiki Day Cruise
services.desc: Let's Adventure! 2 Hours About Every tiki boat tour is private, meaning we don't include anyone else from the public on the boat at the same time as your party. Each tour comes with a captain to drive the boat. Bring your own coolers, drinks, and food, and get ready to enjoy the ride. More Information Up to 3 people are included in the Tour Price and 4-6 people are an additional All Ages • Up to 6 People • 2 Hours

quotes.text: Our trip with Wyatt of Crystal River Tiki Tours on Mar 19, 2025 was excellent. Upon comparing the different operators in the area, we found Tiki Tours was the best choice for us because it was private and could accommodate a party of 3-6 passengers. The price difference was minimal and afforded us a private tour. If you want a private tour that is comfortable and inexpensive then I would highly recommend Crystal River Tiki Tours.

Wyatt’s tiki cruise was awesome!! He called us two hours before our trip because the weather was expected to be bad and he went above and beyond to accommodate us to reschedule our tour. Wyatt was punctual and very knowledgeable about the springs and manatees. He made our trip very memorable. Definitely highly recommend Wyatt’s tiki tour in Crystal River. Thanks, Wyatt!

We thoroughly enjoyed our trip with Wyatt. He was a very personable and wealth of information. We did see a couple of manatees, the springs and learned of the history. The boat is very comfortable and our dog loved the ride too. We plan on taking another trip during the season when hundreds of manatees are in the bay.
